review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: implement bounded shared static argv decoding
review.notes: The supplied Run command Preview is a JSON argv array rather than a cmd string; existing shared codeParts misses that shape. Decode only literal root/command/cmd argv, known shell -c/-lc and explicit python -c/node -e interpreters; no eval, shell expansion, dynamic interpolation, filesystem reads or command execution. Preserve the original first and copy/raw verbatim; outer commands precede explicitly bounded heredoc scripts. Ordinary text/path arguments never imply Python. Reuse RN TypeScript source and generated browser bundle; retained size/node/depth/tab bounds apply. Negative old-source controls must demonstrate the actual screenshot-shaped omission. Component/browser fixtures are synthetic; do not claim actual iPhone/VoiceOver/installed-service acceptance.

cases.description: Static argv wrappers expose correctly typed script views without altering original content
cases.setup: Synthetic JSON/JS arrays, shell command flags, Python/Node eval, mixed heredocs, dynamic AST values, incomplete and oversized input
cases.action: Run production codeParts/formatCode and inspect exact source slices, order and hints
cases.expected: Complete original first; only explicit interpreter script arguments or complete heredocs become previews; literal escapes decode once, no guess from prose/paths, dynamic/unsupported wrappers stay raw; repeated extraction stable and bounded

cases.description: RN Chat/Trace shared code readers select typed argv scripts and copy original
cases.setup: Synthetic argv containing Python heredoc with a trailing shell command, light/dark props
cases.action: Render actual CodeBlock/CodePanel; select original/Shell/Python, toggle formatting, copy from selected script
cases.expected: Actual shared CodeText receives the exact script and language, formatting toggles; selected script never replaces original copy; raw reader has no derived tabs

cases.description: Browser Trace command Preview exposes the same script reading as Chat at desktop/mobile widths
cases.setup: Synthetic pane transcript with command_execution JSON argv, 390/1440 viewport; no real session
cases.action: Open real Trace, expand turn/tool, select Preview Shell/Python and copy; inspect Raw
cases.expected: Typed derived tabs and compact syntax rendering visible, original JSON copy and Raw unchanged; no API sends or nested execution; existing layout can scroll without clipping
